description.narrative: HCFC PHASE-OUT MANAGEMENT PLAN (STAGE I) This HCFC Phase out Management Plan for the Montenegro will be implemented through the combination of investment and non-investment activities in the refrigeration and air-conditioning service sectors of the Montenegro over a period of ten years. Stage I of the Plan will result in the phase out of 10% by 2015, 35% by 2020 and Stage II from 2020 till 2040 in a complete phase out of 100%.
